theorem interval_segment_profile_transport (a y z T b θ : ℝ) (r j : ℕ)
    (hy : |y| < a) (hz : |z| ≤ a) (hT : 0 < T) (hsmall : b ^ 2 ≤ T / 2)
    (hnew : |y + b| ≤ a) (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) :
    (1 / Real.sqrt (segmentEnergy T b θ)) ^ r *
      (1 + |z - (y + θ * b)| / Real.sqrt (segmentEnergy T b θ)) ^ j *
      intervalProfile a (y + θ * b) (segmentEnergy T b θ) z ≤
    (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (3 : ℝ) ^ j * (1 / Real.sqrt T) ^ r *
      (1 + |z - y| / Real.sqrt T) ^ j * intervalIncrementProfile a y T z b := by
publicDeclarationReviews.semanticProofReview: Upper halfline uses u=a-y,v=a-z,d=z-y,b; lower uses u=a+y,v=a+z,d=-(z-y),-b. All sign/energy/new-distance hypotheses follow explicitly. segmentEnergy(T,-b,theta)=segmentEnergy(T,b,theta), both absolute displaced d values agree, and incrementProfile is even in b. Adding the two qualified inequalities yields the EXISTING intervalIncrementProfile, with exactly 2^r*3^j and no additional factor two.
